title: Why doesn’t this electric bell ring just once? #Shorts
description:
A classic self-interrupting electromagnetic bell: holding the button supplies the coil, the armature moves and opens its own contact, current and magnetic pull decay, and the spring returns the armature to reclose the circuit. A battery supplies every cycle. This is an illustrative lumped model, not a measured commercial bell. Simplified translating armature, linear unsaturated magnetic material, ideal hysteretic contact and impact restitution. Open-contact inductive energy dissipates through an effective transient path; arc/contact-bounce details and full 3D field effects are omitted. Time is expanded and replayed for explanation; field lines are schematic.
